title: Profiles and follows — people and institutions, a page for each, and one-tap follow

tasks.title: Profiles, follows and suggestions, API and interface (profile page, Who to follow, settings, Post as)

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in viewer calls `GET /api/v1/profiles/me` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with the viewer's person profile (id, kind `person`, name, bio, follower and following counts, and the institution profiles the viewer administers), creating it on first use with the name from the viewer's token; `PATCH /api/v1/profiles/me` with `{name?, bio?}` (name 1–80, bio 0–300 characters) updates it and answers 200.
scenarios: AC-001 the viewer's own profile is created on first use and can be edited

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in viewer calls `GET /api/v1/profiles/{profileId}` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with the profile (id, kind `person` or `institution`, name, bio, follower and following counts, whether the viewer follows it, and whether it is the viewer's own or one they administer) and its latest posts (the post shape of spec 023); an unknown profile answers 404 `profile.not_found`.
scenarios: AC-002 any profile with its latest posts

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in viewer calls `PUT /api/v1/profiles/{profileId}/follow` THE SYSTEM SHALL record that the viewer follows that profile (idempotent) and answer 200 with `{following: true, followers}`; `DELETE` on the same path stops following and answers `{following: false, followers}`; following one's own person profile answers 400 `follow.self`; an unknown profile 404.

WHEN a signed-in viewer calls `GET /api/v1/profiles?suggested=1` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with up to 6 profiles the viewer does not follow and that are not their own, institutions first, then the people with the most followers.

WHEN a viewer opens `/social/u/$profileId` THE SYSTEM SHALL show the profile's name, a kind label for an institution, its bio, follower and following counts, a "Follow"/"Following" button (none on one's own profile, which links to editing it in settings instead) and its posts; pressing Follow changes the button and the count at once. The feed's rail shows "Who to follow" with the suggested profiles and the same button; author names in the timeline link to their profiles.
scenarios: AC-005 the profile page and Who to follow

acs.text: WHEN a viewer opens `/social/settings?tab=profile` THE SYSTEM SHALL show a form with their name and bio, the bio's remaining characters, and a "Save" button that saves them and says it did; the composer (spec 023) offers "Post as" with the viewer's own profile and each institution they administer.
scenarios: AC-006 editing the profile and posting as an institution
